newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-LENDIS BREAKS 17-YEAR-OLD SAFRICA RECORD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-LENDIS BREAKS 17-YEAR-OLD SAFRICA RECORD.

text.p: Gavin Lendis set a new South African high jump record with a clearance of 2.27 metres at a meeting at Port Elizabeth on Friday night.

The Cape Town athlete knocked Reinhard Schiel's mark of 2.26m, set in Pretoria in October 1979, from the record books but failed at 2.30m in an attempt to achieve Athletics South Africa's tough qualifying standard for this year's world championships in Athens.
